title: Will my savings last in retirement?
scope: The chance that a lump of savings, topped up until retirement and then drawn down each year, lasts the whole retirement. Amounts are in today's money.
limits: A model of possible markets, not a forecast. Returns and volatility are long-run averages; real markets can do worse. It leaves out tax, fund fees, changing spending, CPF payouts and other income.
subject: portfolio

savings.label: Savings today
savings.rationale: A typical mid-career balance to start from; the reader replaces it with their own.

contribution.label: Saved each year until retirement
contribution.rationale: About S$1,000 a month; the reader replaces it with their own.

withdrawal.label: Spending each year in retirement
withdrawal.rationale: About S$3,300 a month in today's money; the reader replaces it with their own.

items.name: Cautious mix
items.notes: Example figures for the format only.
items.rationale: Example estimate: a blend of long-run bond and share returns, weighted 70/30; replace with a real source and period.
